scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.check:quick: npm run check:code && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:code: npm run check:format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:secrets
scripts.check:format: prettier --check frontend eslint.config.js scripts/check-secrets.mjs && uv run --no-sync ruff format --check backend
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings=0 frontend && uv run --no-sync ruff check backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p frontend && uv run --no-sync ty check --error-on-warning backend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend eslint.config.js scripts/check-secrets.mjs && uv run --no-sync ruff format backend
